entities.name: N-Boc deprotection
observations: The mapped transformation removes a tert-butoxycarbonyl group from an exocyclic amine while retaining the brominated heteroaromatic, oxygen-containing, and phosphorus-containing scaffold.

The closest exact record is ORD reaction ord-e48d9ebb92dd43999075f5309d8d3c51; its mapped substrate-to-product change supports deprotection, although the record may contain a mixture or dataset artifact.

entities.name: Acidic Boc cleavage
observations: Likely reagent classes are HCl in dioxane or ethyl acetate, or trifluoroacetic acid in dichloromethane.
These conditions are chemically plausible recommendations rather than definitive conditions reported for the exact transformation.

entities.name: Suzuki coupling conditions
observations: A related record uses Pd/phosphine, base, water, and glyme-like solvent for coupling of the brominated scaffold, but this is not applicable because the submitted product retains bromine and has no newly installed substituent.
